detail.longDescription: arXiv:2609.35776v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bullying in schools profoundly affects the mental and physical health of teenagers. Although existing in-person and digital interventions provide some benefits, they often fall short in addressing the complex social dynamics of bullying. In this study, we collaborated with K-12 teachers to co-design a multi-agent anti-bullying system powered by large language models (LLMs). This system simulates authentic scenarios, enabling students to develop anti-bully skills. The research identifies key design parameters for an LLM-driven multi-agent simulation system, offering valuable insights for creating more effective and scalable anti-bullying tools that could significantly reduce bullying in schools} \keywords{anti-bullying interventions, multi-agent system, generative AI, co-design, bystander presence
